reaction.episode: CORRECTION episode through Nov 2: SPX $7,541.40, -3.86% from its 120-day high, -1.99% vs its 50-day but still +3.13% above its 200-day ($7,312.74). SMH $508.31 is -24.34% from its high and below its 200-day, sitting between zones just above Zone 2 ($470-505); NVDA $202.06 is inside Zone 1 ($200-210). VIX 21.15 is at its 5-day high with no rollover; credit is calm (HY OAS 3.44%). Mechanical capitulation tally 2/4 — zone occupancy and credit calm confirmed, volume climax and VIX rollover not.
reaction.invalidation: A sustained HY OAS print above 4% or an SPX close below its 200-day (~$7,312.74) with breadth breaking voids the Watch stance — the episode is no longer an orderly correction. Conversely, a confirmed bottom (failed first bounce, second low holding, 10Y falling) voids Watch in favor of deployment.

reaction.trapRisk: The pivot-and-fail trap is live: QQQ is -9.06% in a month and TQQQ -26.38%, with SMH down 19.81% in 20 days — every bounce so far has failed into lower lows. Do not chase the first green day; entries wait for a held second low or a close above the failure zone (SPX $7,750-7,820 / SMH $580-600), and any bounce into those zones is a fade, not an entry.

strategyPosture: Watch. The correction is confirmed at index level (SPX -3.86% from its 120-day high, below its 50-day) but capitulation is not: the mechanical tally is 2/4, VIX sits at its 5-day high with no rollover, and SMH is between zones. No new buys; hold existing positions. Tranche A stays armed, not fired, until SMH prints Zone 2 with a stronger tally.

themes.counterRead: Price has repriced the financing, not the demand — but NVDA and AMAT are flagged MULTIPLE_COMPRESSION, so the market is pricing a growth-rate step-down, not just sentiment. The dislocation is real, but there is no floor until a zone print plus tally confirmation; buying the revenue story without the zone print is catching a falling multiple.
